Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. The processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect includes choosing 1 of your opponent's Digimon, suspending the chosen Digimon, and giving the chosen Digimon "that Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn."
Card Q&A.q: If the Digimon chosen for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can't be suspended, does it still gain "that Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn"?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. That Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
